question: The sum of all interior angles of a regular polygon is equal to twice the sum of all its exterior angles. The number of sides of the polygon is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of **interior angles** = (n − 2) × 180°

Sum of **exterior angles** = 360°

Given: (n − 2) × 180° = 2 × 360°

⇒ n − 2 = 4

⇒ n = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of **interior angles** = 2 × Sum of **exterior angles**

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of an **n-sided polygon** = (n − 2) × 180°

Sum of exterior angles of any **convex polygon** = 360°
